description: A dark, candlelit vaulted hall. A man with long dark hair, seen from behind in a black long coat with brass buttons and white cuffs, cuts with large shears at the long beard of an older man in a brocade robe trimmed with brown fur, who looks alarmed with wide eyes. Several bearded men in tall fur hats and dark robes stand back in the shadows, some holding candles. No text, no frame, no visible wounds.
